properties.name: Coded Patient Survival Record Builder
properties.description: Builds survival-ready records by selecting mapped patient ID, follow-up time, and event columns from coded patient records and excluding rows with missing time or event values.

properties.name: survival_table_builder
properties.description: Builds survival records from coded patient records by extracting patient identifier, follow-up time, and event indicator columns named in the column mapping. Records with missing time or event values are excluded.
